title: Text: Corey Wolfgang ↔ Anthony Fenech

searchText: i have been trying to get you a list of the departures in the last two months. due to db.   duane m: exec vp of business operations: one day he just disappeared. we were told he was “removed” and sent to lakeland until he quit or retired or was fired) not sure if he is still even working, but he’s gone.  scott pett vp of ticket sales: fired steve fox director of ticket sales: fired steve harms: corporate sales vp: i believe he was fired.  kelsey decker, manager of ticket sales: left for another job (because of new culture or lack of it) jessica chelsey: premium sales: left for another job because of db. we were having a party for her send off and db walked in and scheduled a last minute meeting so we couldn’t attend her goodbye party (the kind of stuff he does) mikeala higgins: social media coordinator: left for another job cuz of culture.  corey wolfgang: client service rep: fired (was loyal to steve and scott) bryan martin: client service rep (left because of another job, but started looking because of culture)  there are more, but i can’t think of everyone. and of course this doesn’t even include the tons of people that left or got fired by the wings    corey wolfgang
